lodging.note: fill the form on the page, then copy the results URL  type the city; the results URL gains entity_id=…, add it to SKY_HOTEL_ENTITY; property pages are /hotels/{country}/{city}-hotels/{slug}/ht-{id}?checkin&checkout&adults&rooms

car.note: fill the form on the page, then copy the results URL  results URL: /carhire/results/{pickup-id}/{dropoff-id}/{YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM}/{YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM}/{driver-age}; add the id to SKY_CAR_PLACE

lodging.note: returns 0 properties until the city is picked from the page's own search box; then add its city id to TRIP_CITY_IDS

car.note: fill the form on the page, then copy the results URL  results URL carries pcity=, pcode=, ptime=, rtime=; add the airport to TRIP_CAR; long rentals may return 'No suitable cars found' = no-inventory

flights.note: the origin is usually dropped: type it in the 'Flying from' box, then Search

items.title: ETIAS travel authorization
items.text: No visa for stays up to 90 days. The EU's ETIAS pre-travel authorization (about €20 online) is due to start in the last quarter of 2026 with a transition period; check whether it is live for your dates.

items.title: Entry/Exit System (EES)
items.text: Schengen borders now record fingerprints and a photo on your first entry instead of stamping passports.

items.title: Passport
items.text: Valid at least 3 months beyond your departure date, with 2 blank pages.
